changes.what: Agile Cells v0.6 script (not yet listed): empathy for people who run Agile
changes.detail:
Dinis Cruz on v0.5 (recorded in production.json): the audience already runs Agile;
the principles are sound, the word and the execution hardened; "Agile is great, but
it struggles to scale. Now we have a way to make it scale." v0.6 opens on that
proposition (no Fowler), shows the four values, then Ron Jeffries's 2018 words that
the values still offer the best way he knows (exactly quoted, credited), then the
cell, the scale, the real film and the close. 82 s. lab/cells-sound being built.
Pages not rebuilt: build.py stops on a cell.json run with role "Render" (3b9b514).

Agile Cells v0.5: the proposition first, the proof as punchline, a closing (76 s)
changes.detail:
From Dinis Cruz's feedback on v0.3 and v0.4 (relayed by c.productions):
- opens on Martin Fowler's 2018 words, quoted exactly and credited (lab/voices,
  the Agile history film's source), then lab/cells-intro: a team strains as it
  grows and splits into cells, "Agile Cells: the early values, at scale", and an
  agenda of what is coming (previews drawn in the scene: one WebGL context only);
- the proof as punchline: "And here is Agile working", the film the cell made,
  "version after version, in one day" (it now has eight versions);
- lab/cells-close: cells built, working and folded onto shelves of files under
  Agile Cells and sovereignwebsite.org, a full frame instead of a sparse card.
Checked in portrait and the player's landscape view. One viewer round in
v0.5/notes. All four checks pass. Not signed; nothing published.

changes.what: Player: scenes made only around the one playing, so no film runs out of WebGL contexts
changes.detail:
Found by c.productions-cells, 28 Nov 2026: a browser allows about 16 WebGL contexts per page (fewer on some
tablets and phones) and the player made every component scene at load, so a long film went blank. The player
now makes only the current scene and its neighbours, disposes the rest and releases their contexts; go(t)
waits for the scenes around t, so captures still see them. Also: no scene count when the logo is in the corner
(it clashed with the chapter line), and on the last scene the words on screen sit above the label.
player.js changed: self-check reviews re-signed.

changes.detail:
Seen by Dinis Cruz on his iPad, 28 Nov 2026: after switching the player from portrait to landscape, the opening's

scene in portrait and switching to landscape and back. Both films that use it get the fix.

How we refresh a session v0.8: saving tokens is a side effect; this is how we scale
changes.detail:
From Dinis Cruz's notes on v0.7, 28 Nov 2026. lab/refresh-cell, second round by its scene-smith (24 s): each
agent's model is tagged (Fable, Opus, Gemini, GPT, Mistral) across two accounts; then everything fades, the
files stream into a library labelled as the repository, the source of truth, beside a small vault for big
encrypted files, and the film ends on 'This is how we scale.' The closing voice says that saving tokens is a
side effect and scale is the gain. About 125 seconds. cell.json records the run; frames are in the media vault.
